The objective of these notebooks is to rebuild the methods of *An Introduction
to Statistical Learning* chapter by chapter, without using a library for the
model. For every method we first derive the result by hand, then we implement it
in `easylearn`, a small package I am writing along the way, and only at the end
we check the numbers against scikit-learn.
